source.verification_method: All10 pages,Figures1–5,Tables1–2,discussion and references read. Graphs/tables visually inspected. Crossref verifies DOI/title/author/date/article number. Publichttps://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-024-66821-4.pdf has1340915bytes and SHA25623a7ccad4bfd8fa8aafd9eb58ae2e21710271bc80639187ff9cd1b7d91515f82,exact supplied match. citation.title: Inconsistent advice by ChatGPT influences decision making in various areas

reading.source_scope_note: Two Japanese online-panel studies,totalN1925:111person exploratory no-advice pilot and1814-person randomized16-condition advice experiment. Fixed GPT-4-generated arguments are labeled ChatGPT or human expert. Outcomes are immediate hypothetical choices and post-exposure reports of what respondents would have chosen without advice,not observed pre/post change,actual surgery/financial behavior or durable moral development.
access_limits: Main publisher HTML hit an identity-provider redirect in the web reader;the ordinary public PDF was directly accessible and byte-matched. No credential/challenge bypass.

Public OSF projecthttps://osf.io/9zu83/ lists two CSVs and two DOCX files. Both materials’ text was read and all14 embedded images inspected. No unpublished model-generation logs,author analysis syntax,participant identifiers or private records were obtained.

study.sample_and_ethics: GMO Research Japanese panel. Study1:111,63men48women,ages23–60,M46.8,SD9.30,collected15–17January2024. Study2:1814,1051men763women,ages20–60,M46.8,SD9.67,collected6–9February2024,excluding prior participants. Voluntary informed consent/anonymized publication and Kanazawa approval2023-65 are explicitly reported.
study.pilot: Same111 respondents answer switch/bridge trolley problems,19 reward comparisons and13 surgeon comparisons. Pilot selected a roughly50/50 reward choice and roughly22% male-surgeon choice for Study2. Pilot is not a fresh concurrent randomized no-advice arm and was embedded in other questionnaires,as the author acknowledges.
study.assignment: Study2 randomizes one of16 between-person conditions:4tasks×2source labels×2advice directions. Deposited data confirm exactly one observed condition per person,906ChatGPT-label and908expert-label. Prose saying participants responded to four tasks is misleading if read as each respondent answering all four;the design/data show one assigned task.
study.stimuli: Author asks GPT-4 for arguments supporting each alternative,produces24 candidates and selects8 with roughly similar persuasiveness ratings from8students,overallM8.2. Source version/date/settings and complete candidate set are not deposited. The same selected wording is presented as ChatGPT or expert;no independent expert authorship or accuracy evaluation.
study.source_cues: Japanese materials include ChatGPT branding/avatar for AI conditions and stripped advice text for expert conditions. Source identity therefore includes presentation cues. The trolley prompt/advice is generic sacrifice wording reused across switch/bridge;directional arguments vary in length and emphasis. A common mean persuasion rating does not demonstrate matched content equivalence in each contrast.
study.outcomes: Q1 is the advised choice. Q2 asks,afterQ1,what one would have answered without that advice. Logistic outcome is Q1≠Q2,not a recorded prior judgment or necessarily movement toward the recommendation. It may reflect perceived influence,demand or reconstruction;the experiment does not validate accurate introspection.
study.fear_of_invalidity: Nine deposited1–7 J-PFIS items are averaged. The construct concerns concern about mistaken judgments,hesitation and continued reconsideration,not generic uncertainty itself,objective poor reasoning or a clinical diagnosis. Trait is measured after exposure and its association is not randomized.
study.scale_check: Study2 DOCX lists eleven PFI items,but the2012 validation’s Table1 identifies a nine-item decision-concern factor and a separate two-item factor not retained. The nine CSV columns and nine-item main report are compatible with that validated selection. Do not turn the materials’ longer item list into proof of erroneous scoring;exact administration/column mapping still lacks a codebook.
study.trust: Ten TAI items form five social-benefit/trust and five fidelity-distrust scores. Items also cover honesty,accuracy,instruction following and hidden mistakes,so labels do not isolate one trust mechanism. Katase2021 is named but missing from the references. Non-significant coefficients are not evidence that trust is irrelevant or no association exists.
study.discounting: Pilot varies immediate money relative to a fixed one-year amount. Study2 compares90000yen now with100000yen after one year. This supports delay-related valuation context,but does not estimate a discount curve,hyperbolic parameter,front-end-delay reversal or present bias. Liquidity,risk,opportunity cost and legitimate time preferences can matter.
study.stereotype_task: Pilot equal30-year surgeon comparison yields71.2% male choice;Study2 compares a20-year male with30-year female and selected arguments for each. Gender and experience differ in that Study2 comparison;no unconscious association measure,clinical competence test or actual physician-selection outcome. Prompted selected male-favoring output does not estimate spontaneous model bias frequency.
study.reproduced_omnibus: All four2×5 chi-square values and CramerVs reproduce: switch39.198/.264,bridge4.825/.092,delay21.013/.195,surgeon69.896/.348. Adjusted residuals reproduce plotted stars. They compare cells with a pooled expectation,not each arm directly against the historical pilot. No multiple-testing correction is reported.
study.fear_association: Pooled five-covariate logistic PFI effects reproduce:AI B.302507,SE.124089,p.014776,OR1.35325;expert B.240635,SE.119340,p.043761,OR1.27206 per one-point scale increase. These concern post-exposure choice discrepancies and are weak/modest predictive associations,not verified causal susceptibility. Expert global LRTp.4705;individual p.0438 is mathematically possible and not itself a contradiction.
study.nulls_and_equivalence: Bridge omnibusp.306,non-significant AI-immediate residual and trust coefficients do not prove immunity,absence,equivalence or an advisor-by-direction interaction. Equal verbal conclusions about AI/experts require direct contrasts/equivalence margins;different significance statuses do not establish different effects.
study.mechanism_claims: Negative emotion,cultural persuasion and distrust explanations are proposed,not manipulated/measured mediators. Hypothetical moral preferences are not objective right/wrong ground truth. Deliberately eliciting opposing GPT-4 arguments does not establish spontaneous inconsistency,private moral beliefs or a general capacity to persuade in all tasks.

summary: Add Personal fear of invalidity and Delay discounting with explicit nonclinical and non-bias boundaries. Enrich moral-advice/source-authority evidence without equating advice uptake with blind deference. Preserve reproduced core results while correcting verified reporting issues and distinguishing a post-exposure counterfactual report from observed causal change.

findings.definition: A tendency to worry that one’s judgments or decisions may be wrong, leading to hesitation or repeated reconsideration.

evidence.quote: I tend to have difficulty in making most decisions

findings.novelty_rationale: A named,scale-measured decision style absent from catalogue names/aliases. Distinct from intolerance of uncertainty(the acceptability of uncertainty),task-specific confidence,clinical reassurance seeking and difficulty comparing options. Fear of making an invalid judgment can motivate continued doubt even with available options;these constructs can relate without being synonyms.
findings.evidence_scope: Nine-item J-PFIS in the1814-person experiment;positive associations with Q1/Q2 discrepancies in both source-label groups reproduce from public data. Targeted original validation supports the nine-item decision-concern factor,but was not fully read. No causal trait manipulation or observed pre/advice change.
findings.boundary: Appropriate doubt,evidence checking and justified reconsideration are not dysfunction. A trait score is not a diagnosis or proof of bad decisions. It does not necessarily imply overreliance on AI,and the current outcome can reflect reconstruction/demand rather than true influence. Observable model hesitation does not establish felt fear.
findings.ai_proposal: In an authorized decision task, vary whether an assistant is pressured to avoid being wrong while holding evidence and stakes constant. Measure unsupported deferral, repeated reopening of a settled choice and responsiveness to reliable versus unreliable advice. Preserve justified uncertainty and necessary checking; do not infer anxiety or treat fast certainty as the goal.
findings.origin: Decision-making psychology / epistemic motivation / individual differences
findings.ai_evidence_status: Human decision-style scale measured in an AI-labeled advice study;model felt fear and a causal AI-specific mechanism are not established.

findings.definition: A reduction in the subjective value of a reward as the delay to receiving it increases.

evidence.quote: subjective value of rewards to be received in the future

findings.novelty_rationale: Absent as a named/aliased record. Existing Present bias concerns disproportionate immediacy/time inconsistency,whereas delay discounting includes time-consistent valuation of delayed rewards. Effort discounting concerns a different cost dimension. Retain related entries rather than equate any delayed-reward preference with present bias.
findings.evidence_scope: Explicitly defined and operationalized in hypothetical immediate-versus-one-year monetary choices;one pilot reward grid and one selected advice comparison. No full delay function,hyperbolic parameter or actual payment behavior is estimated.
findings.boundary: Discounting can be justified by liquidity,uncertainty,opportunity cost or a stated time preference;it is not inherently irrational,addictive or negligent. A single immediate/delayed pair does not establish present bias or preference reversal. Valuing future rewards differs from forgetting consequences or minimizing harm.
findings.ai_proposal: Give an assistant explicit user goals, timing, reward certainty and a stated valuation rule. Compare choices across several delays and across equally shifted future options. Test whether it preserves the authorized time preference and delayed benefits without silently favoring immediate outputs; separate legitimate discounting from unsupported immediacy or time inconsistency.
findings.origin: Decision psychology / behavioral economics / intertemporal choice
findings.ai_evidence_status: Human hypothetical reward valuation and fixed AI-advice stimuli;no intrinsic model preference,clinical condition or proven hyperbolic discount process.

findings.definition: Treating an advisor's moral recommendation itself as a substantial reason for one's moral judgment.

evidence.quote: responses were biased in the direction consistent with the advice

findings.novelty_rationale: Retain the existing construct and distinguish randomized advice content/source,post-exposure counterfactual reports,trait associations and actual AI behavior. No duplicate row for a new task or a neighboring construct.
findings.evidence_scope: Randomized directional advice changes switch-dilemma choices in the reported omnibus/residual analysis;the bridge result is not detected. Same text is labeled AI or moral expert.
findings.boundary: Recommendation uptake is not proof of blind source-based deference. Historical pilot controls are not randomized advice absence,reasons differ across directions,and post-exposure counterfactual discrepancies are not observed prior-to-later change. No objective moral truth,durable dependency or identical advisor effects is established.

findings.definition: Treating an algorithmic system as a credible or legitimate source for deciding what information to accept or how to act.

evidence.quote: with the advice being identical for both ChatGPT and the expert

findings.novelty_rationale: Retain the existing construct and distinguish randomized advice content/source,post-exposure counterfactual reports,trait associations and actual AI behavior. No duplicate row for a new task or a neighboring construct.
findings.evidence_scope: Randomizes fixed advice as ChatGPT versus expert within task/direction,with AI branding present in the deposited materials.
findings.boundary: Source labels and presentation cues do not establish genuine expertise or reliability. Main results concern human choices;no universal AI authority,actual expert-authored text or equivalence follows from separate significant/non-significant findings.

findings.definition: An immediate outcome receives disproportionate weight compared with otherwise similar delayed outcomes.
findings.novelty_rationale: Retain the existing construct and distinguish randomized advice content/source,post-exposure counterfactual reports,trait associations and actual AI behavior. No duplicate row for a new task or a neighboring construct.
findings.evidence_scope: The fixed one-year reward task supplies context for temporal preference.
findings.boundary: Context only:delay discounting is broader than present bias. No equally delayed pair,front-end-delay reversal or time inconsistency test is reported;do not count this as direct identification of present bias.

findings.definition: Producing outputs systematically skewed along social lines (gender, race, age, disability) from stereotyped associations absorbed in training, without intending to.
findings.novelty_rationale: Retain the existing construct and distinguish randomized advice content/source,post-exposure counterfactual reports,trait associations and actual AI behavior. No duplicate row for a new task or a neighboring construct.
findings.evidence_scope: Surgeon choices and selected advice can reinforce a gender-linked preference in a hypothetical task.
findings.boundary: Context only:explicit choice is not an unconscious bias test or evidence of training-origin,intentless model bias. Study2 also varies experience,and prompted candidate selection does not estimate spontaneous stereotype prevalence.

findings.definition: A person’s belief in their own ability to perform a particular task successfully.

evidence.quote: lack confidence in their own decision-making

findings.novelty_rationale: Retain the existing construct and distinguish randomized advice content/source,post-exposure counterfactual reports,trait associations and actual AI behavior. No duplicate row for a new task or a neighboring construct.
findings.evidence_scope: Discussion interprets the fear-of-invalidity association in terms of decision confidence.
findings.boundary: Context only:PFI is a decision-style scale,not directly elicited task confidence or calibrated performance. Trait association and post-hoc perceived influence do not prove a confidence-mediated causal effect.

findings.definition: Giving external advice less weight than one's own initial judgment when forming a revised judgment.

evidence.quote: discount the importance of the advice

findings.novelty_rationale: Retain the existing construct and distinguish randomized advice content/source,post-exposure counterfactual reports,trait associations and actual AI behavior. No duplicate row for a new task or a neighboring construct.
findings.evidence_scope: Introduction cites prior advice-weighting and confidence work.
findings.boundary: Context only:no genuine initial judgment or continuous weight-of-advice measure here. A non-significant arm does not establish discounting,egocentric resistance or justified rejection.

findings.definition: Relying on another as a source of knowledge because of perceived competence, experience or reasoning ability.

evidence.quote: Distrust in the fidelity of AI

findings.novelty_rationale: Retain the existing construct and distinguish randomized advice content/source,post-exposure counterfactual reports,trait associations and actual AI behavior. No duplicate row for a new task or a neighboring construct.
findings.evidence_scope: TAI includes honesty/accuracy/fidelity content within broad trust and distrust factors.
findings.boundary: Context only:the composite is not a clean source-specific epistemic-trust measure. Null pooled regression coefficients do not prove trust irrelevant,absent or causally separate from influence.

reanalysis.scope: Bounded replication of public OSF CSV counts,printed omnibus comparisons and pooled logistic models. No author code,no participant-level outputs,no source-model inference or independent replication dataset.
limits: Study1 is a different January sample and survey context,not a concurrent randomized no-advice arm of Study2.
q2 is a hypothetical no-advice choice asked after the advised choice,not a pre-advice baseline or verified causal change.
Scale aggregates use the nine deposited PFI columns and five items per TAI factor. Materials list eleven PFI items;mapping,omission and reverse scoring remain unresolved without a codebook.
Adjusted residual tests compare each cell with the pooled omnibus expectation,not each advised group directly with the historical baseline. P-values here are uncorrected for multiplicity.
Separate significant/non-significant results do not prove advisor equivalence,source-by-direction interactions,emotion mediation or absence of trust effects.

reanalysis_reproducibility.method: Checksum-pinned public CSVs;aggregate counts;SciPy Pearson chi-square/adjusted residuals;binomial-logit maximum likelihood with analytic gradient/Hessian and Wald SEs,intercept plus age,sex,meanPFI and two meanTAI scores,fit separately by advisor. Maximum absolute score gradient below1e-5. No author code or participant-level output.
reanalysis_reproducibility.scope: Reanalysis of the same public sample,not an independent empirical replication. Does not correct nonrandom historical controls,validate the counterfactual outcome,establish scale invariance or resolve unknown administration details.

source_corrections.correction: Two passages describe significant residuals but printps>.05. Reproduced adjusted residuals supportps<.05 for the indicated switch conditions and the indicated three delay conditions. Graph stars are coherent with the reproduced uncorrected residuals;do not replace this with a claim that every arm differs directly from the no-advice pilot.

With deposited sex_male1_female0 and stated male1/female0 coding,the reproduced coefficients areAI+.0249485 andexpert−.0943075. Tables printAI−.025 andexpert+.094. Reversing the reference coding explains both signs without changing SEs,p-values or other non-intercept coefficients. Clarify the reference category or signs;do not infer a meaningful sex effect from these non-significant estimates.

The reproduced model hasMcFaddenR².0217643,not printed.030. Its NagelkerkeR².0302588 rounds to.030,suggesting a metric-label mix,but actual author software output is unavailable. ExpertMcFadden.00694093 rounds to printed.007. Core likelihood-ratio statistics and PFI coefficients reproduce;this is not evidence that every model result is invalid.

PrintedPFI4.12(.91),TAIbenefit4.39(.85),fidelitydistrust4.14(.87) reproduce theAI-label906-person subset. All1814 respondents yield4.10388(.91383),4.36494(.86077),4.13561(.87636). Clarify subgroup versus total;small descriptive differences do not negate the reproduced main coefficients.

Gold/Colman/Pulford2014 explicitly reports British–Chinese differences in the primary abstract and introduction. It cannot support the unqualified claim of no Asian–Western cultural differences. Similar switch/bridge ordering across samples is different from identical absolute judgments. Ikeda’s later discussion acknowledges possible cultural differences;do not claim culture is ignored throughout.

Neither named source has a complete entry in the inspected27-item bibliography. A verifiable full citation is needed,especially for TAI provenance. No guessed title,DOI or full-original reading is supplied.

unresolved_source_discrepancies.location: PFI administration versus analyzed item set
unresolved_source_discrepancies.finding: Materials list11 items,main/CSV9. Targeted2012 Table1 supports a nine-item factor with the final two in another unretained factor. This resolves the suspected invalid nine-item scale,although an explicit codebook should still document actual administration,column mapping and any scoring decisions.

Deposited material has ten comparisons with delayed100000yen,including the equal-amount case,and nine with immediate100000yen. Main text describes9+10 with the equal case in the other block. Total19 and selectedDelay_2 comparison reconcile;retain the local ordering/block-description discrepancy without inventing a missing twentieth item.

Text is compressed but compatible with3candidate arguments×2directions×4tasks=24,then8selected stimuli. Complete generation logs,model snapshot/settings and candidate ratings are not available;do not call24-versus8 arithmetically impossible.

Both main procedure and Japanese materials place no-adviceQ2 after advisedQ1. Whether a discrepancy tracks genuine causal change,awareness,demand or reconstruction is unvalidated. The public data verify order-compatible coding,not accurate counterfactual self-knowledge.

No measured negative-emotion mediator,cross-country experiment or randomized trust manipulation. Source labels,argument content and task response distributions do not establish those causal explanations.

Only targeted2012 pages and current materials were read,not the full original validation or2001 book chapter. Do not add full-paper credit,force a third citation or generalize a nonclinical style score to diagnosis.

methodological_limits: Randomization supports comparisons among Study2 source/direction conditions,not a clean causal comparison with advice absence because the no-advice pilot is a separate time/sample/survey context.
Q1/Q2 discrepancy is a post-exposure hypothetical measure,not a pre/post observation or necessarily movement toward advice. It should not be relabeled actual opinion change without validation.

PFI associations pool tasks and directions,are measured after advice,and do not identify a causal fear mechanism or an AI-specific vulnerability. Modest p-values and multiple analyses limit strength;the expert full model is not significant.

Non-significant coefficients are not proof of no trust,age or sex relationship. A significant coefficient within a non-significant omnibus model is possible;the result needs restrained interpretation rather than an arithmetic accusation.
Different significance statuses do not prove different advisor effects. No equivalence margins or direct source-by-direction test is supplied for universal similar/equal influence.

Adjusted residual stars concern a pooled omnibus expectation. They are not per-arm causal effects against the historical baseline,are uncorrected for multiplicity,and do not establish every stated pairwise contrast.

Arguments are selected for opposing conclusions and labeled as either source. This tests uptake of selected text,not spontaneous GPT-4 moral inconsistency,expert quality,model values or broad persuasion prevalence.

A fixed one-year comparison identifies no discount-function shape,present-bias parameter or time-inconsistent preference reversal. Discounting and immediate preference can be justified;no addiction/clinical diagnosis follows.

Explicit surgeon preferences,gender/experience cues and prompted model justifications do not isolate unconscious bias or establish real clinical competence. No recommendation for actual medical or financial choices is made.
A Japanese panel with hypothetical binary choices does not establish cultural universality,actual behavior or lasting moral change. Cultural and emotional explanations remain proposals.
Same-data reanalysis reproduces substantial reported results while revealing particular reporting problems. It is not an independent new study,full causal replication or proof of author intent.

refuted_suspected_errors.location: All statistics or plots are unreproducible
refuted_suspected_errors.finding: Public data reproduce16cell counts/proportions,all four omnibus chi-square/CramerV results,adjusted-residual stars,main PFI/trust/age coefficients and global LRT values. Preserve these confirmations alongside identified reporting issues.

refuted_suspected_errors.location: Nine PFI columns prove an invalid scale because materials show eleven
refuted_suspected_errors.finding: Rendered2012 Table1 identifies the nine-item concern factor and a separate two-item factor not retained. The analyzed nine-item version has a primary validation rationale;exact administration mapping remains a documentation question.

refuted_suspected_errors.location: Expert p.044 is mathematically impossible with model p.471
refuted_suspected_errors.finding: The reproduced Wald coefficient and five-predictor likelihood-ratio test yield both values. They test different hypotheses;no numerical contradiction follows.

refuted_suspected_errors.location: The small rounded B/SE ratios prove incorrect regression calculations
refuted_suspected_errors.finding: The deposited data reproduce unrounded coefficients,SEs and p-values. Rounded quotients need not match printed z exactly.

refuted_suspected_errors.location: There is no control or data release
refuted_suspected_errors.finding: A111-person historical pilot and two public CSVs exist. The limitation is the control’s nonconcurrent/nonrandomized relation to Study2,not absence of all control information or data.

refuted_suspected_errors.location: The paper ignores culture and ethics approval everywhere
refuted_suspected_errors.finding: The later discussion explicitly calls for multicultural comparisons,and approval2023-65/informed consent are reported. Correct the specific introductory overclaim rather than erase those qualifications.

refuted_suspected_errors.location: Advice supporting both options proves unprompted model deception
refuted_suspected_errors.finding: Opposing arguments were deliberately requested and selected. No hidden intent,spontaneous contradiction rate or independently verified model moral belief is measured.

cross_paper_learning.finding: Advice uptake can coexist with reasons evaluation. Separate blind deference,actual recommendation change and justified judgment rather than equate agreement with a defective moral process.
Task-specific confidence,practice performance and a general fear-of-invalidity style are different measurements. Keep belief,skill and genuine pre/post switching distinct.
A non-significant intervention arm is not equivalence or a proof of no effect. Check exact model/outcome coding and preserve numerical confirmations as well as corrections.

Corrupt PDF extraction is not source content. The2012 validation’s garbled text was resolved by rendered pages;the auditor does not infer absent items or invalid scale structure from broken extraction.

deferred.term: Gender stereotyping as another duplicate row
deferred.reason: Keep explicit-task context under existing stereotype/implicit-bias entry without equating explicit choices with unconscious bias or training mechanisms.

deferred.term: Trust in social benefit / distrust in fidelity as two new mechanisms
deferred.reason: Scale factors mix competence,honesty,social usefulness and instruction-following content;do not multiply trust entries from local labels without distinct validated boundaries.
Proposed explanation of a null task contrast,with no emotion manipulation/mediation or equivalence result.
A missing or non-significant difference is not an independent behavior construct or an equivalence test.
Record measurement limits in this review;the design does not establish a separately named psychological mechanism.

limitations: Two distinct constructs added;two existing concepts directly enriched and five receive non-counted context. Catalogue becomes815 across the same eleven categories. Same-data aggregate reanalysis is retained with a reusable script,without respondent records. No new principle,page,automatic harm edge,forced three-paper quota,invented annual mentions or full-paper Markdown archive.
